# `worlds/` — Generated Webots worlds

**What is in here.** One `.wbt` per layout and mode, each stamped with the SHA-256 of the scenario that produced it. The v1 worlds remain alongside.

**How it is produced.** Generated by `scripts/build_worlds.py`. **Do not hand-edit** -- the world check will reject a drifted file.
